description: An insight node in the motivation lattice: a hypothesis that cites its supporting observations, carries confidence and provenance, and may be quarantined.

hypothesis.description: The interpretation, explicitly worded as a hypothesis.

layer.description: Interpretation layer only; implications and actions live in derived fields.

identity_level_flag.description: True when the claim characterizes who the user IS; default quarantine.

evidence_edges.description: Observation IDs supporting this insight (evidence edge targets).

proposed_action.description: Proposed action layer; user decides whether to act.
